name: Sundering of Alara
description: The event in which an unknown planeswalker plundered Alara for its mana, breaking it into five shards.

description_citations.text: "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sundering of Alara separates the shards, which drift apart in the Eternities, and during the Conflux move back toward each other.
timeline.quote: the shards separated and continued to drift further apart over time.

citation.text: "Blind Eternities", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An unknown planeswalker plunders Alara for its mana, shattering the plane into shards in the Sundering.
timeline.quote: an unknown Planeswalker plundered Alara for its mana

citation.text: "Alara", section "The Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grixis is cut off from white and green mana by the Sundering, and demons, witches and necromancers gain power while angels go extinct.

citation.text: "Grixis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves of Naya trace their name to Cylia, the first high priest, who witnessed the breaking of the world, and are led by a succession of Anima.
timeline.quote: They call themselves the Cylian elves after the beautiful Cylia, the first elvish high priest

citation.work: The Movers and Shakers of Naya
